settings.heading: Made for skin that's been through something.
settings.founder_note: I built this for the version of myself who was halfway through treatment and couldn't find skincare she could trust. Fragrance-free, gentle, esthetician-formulated. Comes gift-wrapped if you're sending it to someone who needs it.
settings.reviews_empty_text: Reviews will appear here once your review widget is installed.
settings.cross_desc_1: Begin the day with five minutes of stillness and skin that feels alive.
settings.cross_desc_2: For the seasons when the work is internal.
